privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Thana Glass Group and its affiliates, including Thana Glass Aluminum Co., Ltd. (Headquarters and Branches), Thana Glass Thalang Co., Ltd., and other affiliated entities (hereinafter referred to as "we", "us", or "our"), are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your personal information in compliance with the Thailand Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (PDPA).

sections.heading: 1. Personal Data We Collect
sections.body:
We collect only the personal data necessary for our operations, categorized as follows:

Data you provide directly to us (via the quotation system):
• Full Name
• Telephone Number
• Other contact details (e.g., LINE ID or Email address)
• Company Name and Details (e.g., Tax Identification Number, Company Address)
• Installation address or site location
• Specific product requirements (e.g., glass/aluminum specifications or additional remarks)
• Project information: Photos of the installation site, site conditions, or architectural blueprints provided for price evaluation.

Data collected automatically (when you visit our website):
• IP Address
• Browser type and device information
• Website browsing behavior and usage statistics (via Google Analytics)
• Tracking cookie data (via Facebook Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Google Ads, Remarketing, etc.)

sections.heading: 2. Purposes of Data Collection
sections.body:
We process your personal data for the following purposes:
• To contact you, assess your site, provide a quote, and prepare the necessary details before we start working together.
• To deliver products, provide services, and coordinate other activities.
• To facilitate the internal operations of our sales and engineering teams.
• To analyze user behavior, improve website performance, and enhance user experience (Google Analytics).
• To deliver targeted advertisements, promotions, and relevant information regarding our products and services (Facebook Pixel, TikTok Pixel, Google Ads, Remarketing, etc.).

sections.heading: 3. Disclosure of Personal Data
sections.body:
We do not sell your personal data to third parties. However, we may share or disclose your information under the following circumstances:

Affiliated Companies: We may share your data within the Thana Glass Group to facilitate price evaluations, logistics, installation, and to ensure high-quality service. All affiliates strictly adhere to data protection standards.

Third-Party Service Providers: We may share necessary data with authorized service providers, such as subcontractors for site evaluations, hosting providers, or analytics and marketing platforms (e.g., Google, Meta/Facebook, TikTok).

Legal Compliance: We may disclose your information if required to do so by law or in response to valid requests by public authorities.

sections.heading: 4. Data Retention Period
sections.body:
We will retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy:

For users who request a quotation but do not proceed with a purchase: Your data will be retained for a period of 3 years from the date of the last contact.

For customers who purchase products or services: Your data will be retained for 10 years following the completion of the service. This is required for product warranties, after-sales support, and compliance with accounting and tax regulations.

Upon the expiration of the retention period, or upon your valid request for deletion, we will securely delete, destroy, or anonymize your personal data.

sections.heading: 5. Use of Cookies
sections.body: Our website uses cookies to optimize functionality and improve your browsing experience. You can manage your preferences or disable non-essential cookies through the "Cookie Settings" on our website.

sections.heading: 6. Your Data Privacy Rights
sections.body:
Under the PDPA, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
• Right to Withdraw Consent: You may withdraw your consent at any time.
• Right to Access: You have the right to request access to and obtain a copy of your data.
• Right to Rectification: You can request the correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
• Right to Erasure: You may request the deletion, destruction, or anonymization of your data.

sections.heading: 7. Contact Information
sections.body:
If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or wish to exercise your rights, please contact us at:

Address: 46/9 Moo 6, Chalong, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83130, Thailand

terms.title: Terms and Conditions of Website Use
terms.intro: Welcome to the Thana Glass Group website. By accessing and using this website, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions. If you do not agree with these terms, please discontinue your use of the website immediately.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose of the Website
sections.body: This website serves as an informational platform to showcase our product catalogs, installation portfolios, and company details. It also features a "Request for Quotation" system, allowing users to submit initial specifications for price evaluation. This website is not an E-Commerce platform for direct online purchasing and payment.

sections.heading: 2. Pricing and Quotation Policy
sections.body:
Because our products and services are primarily project-based, made-to-order, or involve custom contracting works, pricing must be evaluated based on material volume, specifications, and actual site conditions.

Non-Display of Retail Prices: The company does not display retail pricing on this website. Users must submit a request via the quotation system to receive an accurate net price and formal quotation.

Quotation Requests: Submitting a request through the website does not constitute a legally binding sales agreement. It is solely a request for the company to issue an official Quotation.

Evaluations and Adjustments: Initial estimates are based on the dimensions and details provided by the user. Should a physical Site Survey reveal discrepancies in measurements, site conditions, or installation complexity, the company reserves the right to adjust the final quotation accordingly.

Exclusions: Unless explicitly stated in the official quotation, product prices and initial estimates do not include costs for structural modifications, masonry works, dismantling of existing fixtures, scaffolding rentals, or specialized logistical fees (e.g., cross-island transportation).

Validity: Quotations are valid only for the period specified within the document, and prices are subject to fluctuations in market material costs.

sections.heading: 3. Accuracy of User Information
sections.body: Users agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information (e.g., name, contact number, installation address) when submitting a quotation request. The company reserves the right to suspend services or cancel any request if the provided information is found to be false, inaccurate, or submitted with fraudulent intent.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content on this website—including texts, graphics, logos, images, portfolios, and source codes—is the exclusive intellectual property of Thana Glass Group or its licensors. Unauthorized reproduction, modification, distribution, or commercial use without prior written consent from the company is strictly prohibited and subject to legal action.

sections.heading: 5. Limitation of Liability
sections.body:
The company shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, this website.

The company assumes no responsibility for manufacturing errors resulting from inaccurate dimensions or specifications provided by the user online. Actual production will commence only based on measurements taken during an official site survey and formally approved in writing by the customer.

sections.heading: 6. Privacy Policy
sections.body: Your use of this website is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which details how we collect, use, and protect your personal data. We strongly encourage you to review it.

sections.heading: 7. Amendments to the Terms
sections.body: The company reserves the right to modify or update these Terms and Conditions at any time without prior notice. Continued use of the website following any changes constitutes your acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: 8. Governing Law
sections.body: These terms and conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Thailand. Any disputes arising in connection with these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Thai courts.

sections.heading: 9. Contact Information
sections.body:
For any inquiries regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact:
